policies.evaluation_role: previously inspected development months, not a new independent test
policies.holdout: original 2018-05-26 onward period is not scored in this experiment
policies.primary_schedule: 60 days fixed before results; 30 days is sensitivity analysis, not selected on evaluation
policies.train: approvals before validation_start - wait_days; labels strictly before validation_start
policies.validation: 30 approval days ending evaluation_start - wait_days; labels strictly before evaluation_start
policies.evaluation: same original monthly eligible-completed cohorts; labels retrospective
policies.selection: per schedule/fold, minimum validation alerts at recall floor; ties FP, AP, fixed candidate order
policies.features: 90-day delivery events strictly before approval; calendar-day durations; directed state route
policies.history_bias: completed valid-delivery events only; pending/cancelled outcomes are not included
policies.wait_tradeoff: waiting changes cohort date ranges and recency, not solely label coverage
policies.promotion: research artifacts only; original and balanced inference defaults unchanged
policies.recall: validation recall floor does not guarantee later recall

legacy_context.note: same evaluation orders, different training/validation cohorts; no causal wait effect

split.maturity_scope: Maturity exclusions are within the existing valid delivered cohort only; they are not coverage estimates for all approved orders.
split.recency_tradeoff: Larger waits move both train and validation approval cohorts earlier; this changes recency and training size as well as label maturity.
split.evaluation_role: retrospective development backtest; never model or threshold selection

approval_cohort_audit.scope: Raw orders with non-null approval timestamps, using the same approval cohorts; status counts describe the supplied raw table, not status as of a historical cutoff. Cancelled, unknown and other excluded orders receive no inferred delivery label. No dataset snapshot date is assumed.

threshold_policy.objective: minimize validation alert count subject to recall >= min_recall
threshold_policy.tie_policy: highest feasible observed threshold; all equal scores receive the same prediction
threshold_policy.evaluation_note: Validation recall does not guarantee recall on evaluation or future orders
